options.player_question: How's it going?
options.npc_answer: I just escaped with: [inventory_list]. You look like you've seen better days too.

options.player_question: You look like you've been through hell.
options.npc_answer: Hell? No, this is just corporate cost-cutting with extra steps. At least in hell, the medical benefits would be better.

options.player_question: I saw Exxoil trucks heading into the jungle. What's out there?
options.npc_answer: They're not bringing supplies out. They're bringing something in. Big crates. Military grade. If you want to know more, check the abandoned warehouse near Pump Station 3. Just... don't get caught.

options.player_question: I found a Gethulius lab coat. What were they really researching?
options.npc_answer: You didn't find that. Burn it. But if you're curious... the incinerator at the old medical wing. Check the ash pits. Some files don't burn completely.

options.player_question: I found a family photo with a Rosskrild logo. Mean anything?
options.npc_answer: That's the Silva family. The 'S' in Rosskrild and Silva. They had a compound in the hills. Before the outbreak. Before the military came. If you found that photo... you were close. Very close.

options.player_question: I need to get off this island. Any ideas?
options.npc_answer: The docks are watched. But there's a man—Cabral. Old fisherman. He hides his boat in the mangroves on the east shore. Tell him the tide is rising. He'll know what that means.

options.player_question: How do I stay alive out here?
options.npc_answer: Don't trust the water. Don't trust the food. Don't trust anyone who smiles too much. Here's a map. The safe zones are marked in pencil—they change daily.

options.player_question: Any way to get around faster?
options.npc_answer: Exxoil left keys in all their jeeps. Same ignition. Corporate cost-cutting. Try these—they might work.

options.player_question: How do I make weapons?
options.npc_answer: Scavenge the refineries. Scrap Metal and Duct Tape. Combine with a pipe. Crude but effective. The infected don't care if your gun is pretty.

options.player_question: I checked that Exxoil warehouse. Found weapons. Lots of weapons.
options.npc_answer: Then you know. They're stockpiling. For what? The infected don't need bullets. The rogues don't have armor. So who are they preparing to fight? Think about it.

options.player_question: I searched the incinerator. Found partial files. 'Vaccine-B.'
options.npc_answer: Burn them. Burn them now. That's not a vaccine. That's a designation. B stands for 'Biological Weapon.' Gethulius wasn't curing anything. They were engineering it.

options.player_question: I found the Silva compound. It's... empty. But clean. Too clean.
options.npc_answer: Because they left in a hurry. The day the military arrived with the 'survivors.' The Silvas knew something. They tried to warn Rosskrild. No one listened. Now they're gone.

options.player_question: I told Cabral the tide is rising. He just stared at me.
options.npc_answer: Because you're still alive. He's testing you. Bring him something from the mainland—a newspaper, a passport, anything that proves you're not corporate. Then he'll talk.

options.player_question: What happened to the continent?
options.npc_answer: Brazil fell first. Then the rest. The Plague didn't care about borders. Only the islands survived. For now.

options.player_question: Why did the helicopters leave us?
options.npc_answer: Standard protocol. Next Petrol doesn't rescue liabilities. We are the liability now. Every person is a potential carrier.

options.player_question: Exxoil is stockpiling weapons. Who's the enemy?
options.npc_answer: Each other. The alliance is breaking. Rosskrild blames Gethulius. Gethulius blames Exxoil. Exxoil blames everyone. When the shooting starts, we're all caught in the middle.

options.player_question: I found Exxoil documents. 'Project Phoenix.' What is it?
options.npc_answer: Where? Where did you find those? That's the failsafe. If the islands fall, they burn everything. Incendiaries. Planted across the jungle. We're standing on a bomb.

options.player_question: I found more incinerator files. 'Patient Zero: Age 7. Female.'
options.npc_answer: Don't. Please. That's my daughter. They brought her back. They said she was immune. She wasn't. She was just the first. The first to turn. The first to spread it.

options.player_question: Gethulius had a cure. Why did they burn it?
options.npc_answer: Because a cure doesn't make money. A treatment does. Vaccines are one dose. Treatments are forever. Welcome to corporate healthcare. They let the world burn for quarterly profits.

options.player_question: The Silva compound had a bunker. Sealed from the inside.
options.npc_answer: Then they're still in there. The family. Trapped. Waiting. Rosskrild won't open it—too afraid of what's inside. Too afraid of what they'd find. Their own partners. Dead or worse.

options.player_question: I found a journal. 'Operation Golden Harvest: Complete. Asset acquired.'
options.npc_answer: Asset. They called a child an asset. Rosskrild ordered that mission. They wanted 'survivors' to study. They got Patient Zero instead. And now we all pay.

options.player_question: I brought Cabral a newspaper. He finally talked.
options.npc_answer: Good. Then you know about the signal. The old radio tower. If you can power it, you can reach the continent. But Exxoil guards it. They don't want anyone leaving. Bad for morale. Bad for control.

options.player_question: Cabral says the boat is ready. When do we go?
options.npc_answer: Midnight. East shore. Three flashes from a light. If you're late, you're left. If you're followed, we're all dead. Don't tell anyone. Not even me. I might be forced to talk.

options.player_question: I found the warehouse. Crates marked 'Confidential.'
options.npc_answer: Open one. Go on. I'll wait. See? Weapons. Modern. Military. Not for infected—for people. Exxoil is preparing for war with the other corporations.

options.player_question: I opened a crate. Found documents. 'Project Phoenix.'
options.npc_answer: You need to leave. Now. Forget you saw that name. If Exxoil knows you know... Just go. And if you value your life, never speak of it again.

options.player_question: I need to know more about Project Phoenix.
options.npc_answer: Fine. You want the truth? The islands are rigged. Explosives. Every refinery, every pump, every jungle path. If one corporation falls, they all burn. It's mutual assured destruction. And the detonator? It's in Exxoil HQ. Guarded by men who've already accepted death.

options.player_question: I dug through the ash. Found partial lab notes.
options.npc_answer: Read them. Really read them. You'll see it—the dates. The outbreak started Gethulius began their 'vaccine trials.' Not before. They didn't find the cure. They created the plague.

options.player_question: The notes mention a child. Subject 001.
options.npc_answer: My little girl. They took her from the mainland. Said she was special. Said she could save us all. Instead, she became the first. The original. Patient Zero.

options.player_question: Is she still alive? Your daughter?
options.npc_answer: Somewhere out there. Still moving. Still... existing. The infected don't die. They just... persist. Sometimes I think I hear her at night. Calling for me. I can't go. I can't face her.

options.player_question: The Silva compound. I'm inside. It's like they vanished.
options.npc_answer: They didn't vanish. They ran. When the military came back with the 'survivors,' Mrs. Silva saw one. A little girl. She screamed. Said 'we brought death.' Next morning, the compound was empty.

options.player_question: Where did the Silvas go?
options.npc_answer: The bunker. Sealed themselves in. Rosskrild sends food every week. Leaves it at the airlock. No one comes out. No one goes in. Whatever's in there... it's not human anymore.

options.player_question: I found military files. Rosskrild ordered the retrieval mission.
options.npc_answer: They wanted to be heroes. 'Save the survivors.' Instead, they doomed us all. The Silva family knew. They tried to stop it. Now they're trapped in that bunker, and we're trapped out here.

options.player_question: I found Cabral. He said 'prove you're not corporate.'
options.npc_answer: He wants something authentic. Something from before. A wedding ring. A child's drawing. A letter. Something that proves you're human, not a logo. Find that, and he'll trust you.

options.player_question: I found a child's drawing. 'To Daddy.' Will this work?
options.npc_answer: Yes. This is real. This is pain. Cabral will understand. Take it to him. He'll tell you about the signal. About the tower. About the price of freedom.

options.player_question: Cabral told me about the tower. How do I reach it?
options.npc_answer: Through Exxoil territory. Through the infected zones. Through hell. But if you make it, power it up, and send the signal... someone might answer. Might. No guarantees. Just hope.

options.player_question: I powered the tower. Sent the signal. Now what?
options.npc_answer: Now we wait. Cabral will watch the horizon. Three days. If a ship comes, we go. If not... we try again. Or we die trying. Either way, we're free of this place.

options.player_question: Exxoil knows I know about Phoenix. They're hunting me.
options.npc_answer: Then you have two choices. Run and hide. Or find the detonator first. Control the fire. Become the devil they fear. Your move.

options.player_question: If you could see your daughter one last time...
options.npc_answer: I'd ask her to forgive me. For letting them take her. For not fighting harder. For surviving when she didn't. Now go. Before I remember that you're still alive and she's not.

options.player_question: Rosskrild caused all this. They should pay.
options.npc_answer: They are paying. Every day. Watching their paradise rot. Watching their partners die. Watching their family seal themselves in a tomb. Hell isn't fire. Hell is consequences.

options.player_question: The ship came. Cabral's boat is waiting. Come with me.
options.npc_answer: I can't. I've been here too long. The island is in my blood now. But you... you go. Live. Tell them what happened here. Tell them we tried. Tell them we failed. Tell them... we're sorry.
